test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following languages was generally used in Ashoka’s inscriptions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prakrit.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The inscriptions were composed in the Prakrit language** (in Magadhi, the lingo of Prakrit in Magadha)** and written in Brahmi script all throughout most of the domain.
 
• The Prakrits were Center Indo-Aryan dialects spoken between around** 500 B.C. also, 500 A.D.**
 
• The main Sanskrit engraving is from** 150 Promotion,** while we have Prakrit engravings from as soon as **300 BC.**
 
• Magadhi Prakrit is one of the three Sensational Prakrits, the composed dialects of Old India following the decay of **Pali and Sanskrit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pali** is a Center Indo-Aryan ceremonial language local to the Indian subcontinent.
 
• **Saka language**, additionally called Khotanese, Center Iranian language spoken in Xinjiang, in northwestern China, by the Saka clans.
 
• The Sanskrit language has been spoken since** 5,000 years **before Christ.
 
• Sanskrit is at this point the power language of India.
